title: File:USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) underway in the Atlantic Ocean on 30 January 2019 (190130-N-PW716-1312).JPG
art: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Clint Davis
desc: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) underway in the Atlantic Ocean during a strait transit exercise on 30 January 2019. Abraham Lincoln, with assigned Carrier Air Wing 7 (CVW-7), was underway conducting a composite training unit exercise with Carrier Strike Group (CSG) 12.

title: File:USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) underway in the South China Sea on 8 May 2006 (060508-N-4166B-030).jpg
art: Photographer's Mate 3rd Class Jordon R. Beesley
desc: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) and aircraft from Carrier Air Wing 2 (CVW-2) perform an aerial demonstration in the South China Sea on 8 May 2006. Abraham Lincoln was deployed to the Western Pacific from 27 February to 8 August 2006.
